title: Choose the execution contract
description: Describe the source, destination shape, and outage requirement. The lab compares those requirements with NiFi's Traditional and Stateless execution semantics.
modelNote: This decision model follows the current Apache NiFi User Guide. Processor-specific behavior still matters: verify acknowledgments, relationships, side effects, state, and retry behavior for every component in the actual flow.

sources.label: Acknowledged queue or request
sources.detail: Kafka, JMS, queueing services, and request protocols can redeliver when NiFi does not acknowledge completion.

sources.label: Unacknowledged byte stream
sources.detail: A lower-level stream without application acknowledgment cannot be asked to resend data after an in-flight loss.

destinations.label: One destination
destinations.detail: One source-to-destination unit can be rolled back without repeating an already-completed sibling destination.

destinations.label: Multiple destinations
destinations.detail: A later failure can cause an earlier external send to be repeated when the whole unit is retried.

outagePolicies.label: Persist work during an outage
outagePolicies.detail: Keep completed upstream processing in durable inter-processor queues and resume at the blocked step.

outagePolicies.label: Roll back the whole unit
outagePolicies.detail: Ask the source to redeliver and run the process group again when any step fails.

boundaries.label: Processor transaction boundaries
boundaries.detail: Each processor commits independently and transfers the FlowFile to a persistent connection.

boundaries.label: Process-group transaction boundary
boundaries.detail: Treat the stateless process group as one unit and commit only after the destination succeeds.

engines.label: Traditional engine
engines.queueDurability: Inter-processor queues are restored after restart
bestWhen: A destination outage must be buffered
One FlowFile is delivered to multiple destinations
Processors need independent schedules or durable intermediate queues

engines.label: Stateless engine
engines.queueDurability: In-flight data is not persisted across restart
bestWhen: The source provides application-level acknowledgment and redelivery
The flow has one source and one destination
The whole process group should succeed or roll back as one unit
Long-lived buffering inside NiFi is not required
